encoder.input_rule: Only collector-visible normalized entity/event attributes, counts, degrees, and timestamps may contribute to x.

label_separation.class_label_location: run/group manifest and supervised target tensor only
label_separation.allowed_identifier_use: Host/entity/run IDs may be used transiently for deterministic de-duplication, node ordering, grouping, and manifest joins; their raw values and hashes are not model features.

feature_leakage_controls.host_and_path: Replace hostnames, usernames, paths, domains, and stable source identifiers with a per-corpus keyed de-identification mapping before model input. Preserve only presence/type/count semantics required by the R3 schema.
feature_leakage_controls.command_lines: Do not pass literal command-line, action-name, playbook-name, ground-truth, or tool identifiers. Parse only declared process presence/type and normalized event class; record scrub counts.
feature_leakage_controls.event_tokens: Map tokens through the frozen R3 vocabulary. Unrecognized tokens route to event_other_norm; no label-derived token map may be added during acquisition.
feature_leakage_controls.time: Use relative collector timing within a group/subgraph only; do not expose absolute engagement date, red-team schedule, or partition ID.
feature_leakage_controls.graph: Edges are collector-visible causal relations only. Ground-truth edges, analyst annotations, and post-hoc subgraph expansion are forbidden.
feature_leakage_controls.encoder_fitting: R3/R4 use fixed constants and no fitted vocabulary/statistics. If a future transform is fitted, train groups alone may fit it and a new contract/version is required.

formal_dataset.name: FA1B2de
formal_dataset.denial: No raw records, graphs, labels, outcomes, action IDs, playbook IDs, hashes, or derived statistics enter Track-L train, validation, calibration, adapter fixtures, seed selection, or retry decisions.

artifact_track_o: packaged Sample tensors as Track-L training examples
post_hoc_inputs: validation/test outcomes used to change the frozen split or encoder
contamination_denylists.action_execution: No FA1B2de or other unapproved APT action is executed as part of R5.

before_partition_assignment: Scan source/provider manifests, filenames, metadata, labels, and annotations for denylisted formal identifiers and quarantine matches.
Compute SHA-256 for every raw object, canonical record, graph, and encoded tensor; compare exact hashes to any available formal/evaluation manifest.
Canonicalize record identity as (deidentified_host_id, normalized_timestamp_ms, canonical_entity_ids, event_class, source_record_id) and quarantine duplicates across prospective groups.
Detect overlapping UTC windows and shared source object IDs across groups; quarantine both groups rather than assigning one arbitrarily.
Verify labels are present only in the target/manifest channel and run the encoder with labels/identifiers removed.
after_partition_assignment: Recompute raw/graph/feature hashes and assert no hash occurs in more than one partition.
Run feature-column provenance checks: every nonzero feature has a declared R3 source field and no forbidden field is in its dependency trace.
Audit class counts and group counts without moving a group; failure blocks training release.
Compare train/validation/calibration source revisions, host/run IDs, and time windows for cross-group overlap.
audit_algorithm.decision_rule: Any unresolved hit, duplicate, overlap, or provenance gap yields CONTAMINATION_UNRESOLVED and blocks acquisition/training. There is no silent deletion or relabeling.

required_evidence: denylist scan report including zero-hit result
